postProcessors.data: pm.test("có cả Patient và Observation", () => { const ty = (pm.response.json().entry || []).map(e => e.resource.resourceType); pm.expect(ty).to.include('Patient'); pm.expect(ty).to.include('Observation'); });

pm.test("Content-Location có id job", () => { const m = (pm.response.headers.get('Content-Location') || '').match(/bulkdata\/([^\/]+)\/status/); pm.expect(m).to.not.eql(null); pm.variables.set('job_id', m[1]); });

pm.test("đúng 1 study", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j[0]['0020000D'].Value[0]).to.eql(pm.variables.get('studyUid')); });
